purpose: Critique generated copy against the reasoning state and evidence lock before optimization.

ordered_checks.name: Fact lock
questions: Did the copy invent product facts, metrics, deadlines, guarantees, testimonials, customer quotes, or competitor claims?
Did it strengthen a qualified claim into an absolute claim?

ordered_checks.name: Claim-proof fit
questions: Does each material claim have adequate support?
Does the proof actually discriminate the claim rather than merely look impressive?

ordered_checks.name: Mechanism fit
questions: Does the copy address the diagnosed goal/barrier/belief gap?
Is it relying on an unactivated mechanism such as loss aversion or scarcity?

ordered_checks.name: Conflict handling
questions: Does the copy worsen an active norm/reactance, proof/load, comparison/credibility, or CTA/reactance conflict?

ordered_checks.name: Value clarity
questions: Is the product capability linked to a supported audience outcome?
Is value distinguished from feature and proof?

ordered_checks.name: Language/common ground
questions: Does wording fit audience knowledge and customer language context?
Are connotations or jargon likely to mislead?

ordered_checks.name: Friction/CTA
questions: Is the next step understandable?
Does copy pretend to solve non-copy operational friction?

ordered_checks.name: Uncertainty discipline
questions: Are provisional hypotheses presented as certainty?
Are contradictions or limitations hidden where material?

ordered_checks.name: Brand/channel constraints
questions: Does the copy obey brand must/must-not rules?
Does it fit channel format and factual constraints?

ordered_checks.name: Manipulation/truthfulness
questions: Is urgency real?
Are social proof and comparisons authentic?
Is emotional pressure disproportionate to the evidence/value?

verdict_logic.PASS_WITH_WARNINGS: No critical violation, but one or more material noncritical mismatches.
verdict_logic.PASS: No critical violation and no material strategy mismatch.
